test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:
"To make bricks without straw."

options.text: To waste time doing easy work
To build something using traditional methods
To attempt something without the necessary resources
To work in a construction-related job

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. To attempt something without the necessary resources**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"To make bricks without straw"** means attempting to accomplish something without having the necessary materials or resources. (जरूरी संसाधनों के बिना कुछ करने का प्रयास करना) • **Example: **Without proper funding, the team was trying to make bricks without straw in completing the project. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. To attempt something without the necessary resources**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To waste time doing easy work** (आसान काम में समय बर्बाद करना) • **Example:** Spending hours rearranging papers instead of working on the report is a waste of time. • **Option 2: To build something using traditional methods** (पारंपरिक तरीकों का उपयोग करके कुछ बनाना) • **Example:** The craftsman built the house using traditional methods and materials. • **Option 4: To work in a construction-related job** (निर्माण से संबंधित नौकरी में काम करना) • **Example:** He has been working in a construction-related job for over a decade. ca:T698, The correct answer is **Option 1**.
